screening_decisions.reason: This study examines bias from unpublished rating scales in schizophrenia trials. It does not investigate benzodiazepines for treatment of tardive dyskinesia.
This is a systematic review comparing first vs second-generation antipsychotics regarding TD risk. It is not an RCT testing benzodiazepines for TD treatment.
This study examines haloperidol serum concentrations and therapeutic response in schizophrenia. It does not involve benzodiazepines or TD treatment.
This is an animal study investigating GABA changes in dyskinetic monkeys. It is not a human RCT testing benzodiazepines for TD.

This study tests diazepam (a benzodiazepine) in patients with tardive dyskinesia using a 24-week crossover design with blind raters. It directly addresses the review question of benzodiazepines for TD treatment.
This is a review article updating TD incidence rates with first vs second-generation antipsychotics. It does not test benzodiazepines for TD treatment.
This is a review paper discussing extrapyramidal symptoms with atypical antipsychotics. It does not test benzodiazepines for TD treatment.
This study links BPRS scores to CGI ratings in schizophrenia trials. It does not involve benzodiazepines or TD treatment.
This is a review discussing benzodiazepine education and clinical practice. It is not an RCT testing benzodiazepines for TD treatment.
This is a review describing TD incidence study designs and risk factors. It does not test benzodiazepines for TD treatment.
This is a statistics note about cluster-randomized trials methodology. It is not a clinical trial testing benzodiazepines for TD.
This is an observational study examining predictors of TD improvement after stopping neuroleptics. It does not test benzodiazepines as an intervention.
This is a methodological paper comparing therapeutic efficacy indices. It does not test benzodiazepines for TD treatment.
This paper describes the Brief Psychiatric Rating Scale instrument. It is not a clinical trial testing benzodiazepines for TD.
This is a review discussing atypical antipsychotics, drug-induced movement disorders, and discontinuation syndromes. It does not test benzodiazepines for TD treatment.
This paper discusses benzodiazepine abuse and dependence issues. It does not test benzodiazepines for TD treatment in an RCT.

This is a Cochrane review of non-benzodiazepine GABA agonists (baclofen, valproate, etc.) for TD. The selection criteria explicitly exclude benzodiazepines from this review, so it does not address our review question.
This is a statistical methods paper about detecting skewness from summary data. It is not a clinical trial testing benzodiazepines for TD.
This is a general discussion paper about clinical research for schizophrenia treatment. It does not test benzodiazepines for TD treatment.
This is a Cochrane review of calcium channel blockers for TD. It does not test benzodiazepines for TD treatment.
This study is about validating the PANSS rating scale for schizophrenia symptoms, not about benzodiazepines for TD treatment. No benzodiazepine intervention.
Systematic review/meta-analysis comparing FGA vs SGA risk of TD, not an RCT testing benzodiazepines for TD treatment.
RCT comparing haloperidol dosing regimens for acute schizophrenia, not about TD or benzodiazepines.
Controlled study comparing two benzodiazepines (diazepam vs nitrazepam) for postneuroleptic TD in 20 patients. Meets criteria as RCT testing benzodiazepines for TD.
Controlled study of clonazepam (benzodiazepine) vs phenobarbital in 21 psychiatric patients with TD. Meets criteria as RCT testing benzodiazepine for TD.
Single-dose challenge study testing multiple drugs including diazepam, not a proper RCT design for TD treatment evaluation.
Cochrane review about vitamin E for TD, not benzodiazepines.
Observational cohort study about mortality, not an RCT testing benzodiazepines for TD.
Cochrane review about cholinergic drugs for TD, not benzodiazepines.
Cochrane review about catecholaminergic drugs for TD, not benzodiazepines.
RCT testing tetrabenazine with diazepam as control, but primary intervention is tetrabenazine not benzodiazepine.
Despite title mentioning diazepam, abstract describes animal study (rats) about Purkinje cells and GVHD, not human RCT for TD.
RCT testing naltrexone alone or with clonazepam, but primary intervention is naltrexone (opioid antagonist), not benzodiazepine.
Prospective observational naturalistic study comparing outcomes, not an RCT testing benzodiazepines.
Review article discussing various TD treatments including clonazepam, not an original RCT.
12-week double-blind placebo-controlled randomized crossover trial of clonazepam in 19 chronically ill patients with TD. Clearly meets all criteria.

ABA research design testing diazepam (benzodiazepine) in 21 patients with TD. While not classic parallel RCT, it is experimental design testing benzodiazepine for TD. Conservative include per guidelines.
Methodological paper about funnel plots and meta-analysis bias detection, completely unrelated to TD or benzodiazepines.
Methodological paper about meta-analysis issues, not related to TD or benzodiazepines.
General review article about TD epidemiology, pathophysiology, and prevention, not an RCT testing benzodiazepines.
This is a methodological paper about meta-analysis techniques for cross-over trials. It does not report an RCT investigating benzodiazepines for TD treatment.
This study investigates tardive AKATHISIA (not tardive dyskinesia) and uses benztropine and propranolol (not benzodiazepines). Wrong condition and wrong intervention.
This is a methodological paper about meta-analysis inconsistency measurement. Not an RCT about benzodiazepines for TD.

While this study examines diazepam (a benzodiazepine) for TD, it uses an ABA design (quasi-experimental), not a randomised controlled trial. The abstract explicitly states 'A rater-blind, ABA's design study of 21 cases'.
This is a methodological paper about survey design and intraclass correlations from the Health Survey for England. Not related to benzodiazepines or TD treatment.
This is a methodological paper evaluating the impact of CONSORT statement on RCT reporting quality. Not an RCT about benzodiazepines for TD.
This study compares olanzapine vs haloperidol regarding TD incidence. While it involves TD and antipsychotics, it does not investigate benzodiazepines as an intervention for treating TD.
This is a methodological paper about attrition issues in psychopharmacology RCTs. Not an RCT about benzodiazepines for TD treatment.
This is a systematic review of methods for evaluating cluster-based interventions. Not an RCT about benzodiazepines for TD.
This appears to be a review/theoretical paper about the pathophysiology of TD (free radical involvement). Not an RCT investigating benzodiazepines for TD treatment.
This is a methodological paper about assessing quality of controlled trials in systematic reviews. Not an RCT about benzodiazepines for TD.
This is a methodological paper about statistical errors in physician behavior studies. Not related to benzodiazepines or TD treatment.
This is a methodological paper about imputing missing standard deviations in meta-analyses. Not an RCT about benzodiazepines for TD.
This is a longitudinal observational study (14-year follow-up) tracking TD and parkinsonism in psychiatric inpatients. It is not an RCT and does not investigate benzodiazepines as an intervention.
